name: rf
description: RingFrame: turn one explicit intent into a confirmed native prompt, evaluate the exact result, record the decision

interface.shortDescription: Explicit Ask, Eval, and Seal inside Codex
interface.longDescription: Ask compiles one intent into a confirmed prompt for a native Codex capability and hands it to you to submit. Eval checks an exact result against it. Seal records the decision. Requires the ringframe CLI (uv tool install ringframe) and, for confirmation outside Plan mode, `codex features enable default_mode_request_user_input`.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $rf:ask to turn an intent into a confirmed Codex prompt.
